notes: Intermodal business was sold to Hub Group, so it is excluded. Warehouse footprint is not described.

freight_storage_service.value: Full truckload transportation, plus dedicated, drayage and brokered logistics services

transport_asset_model.value: Company-owned late-model fleet of trucks and trailers, supplemented by third-party carrier partners

warehouse_footprint_capacity.value: Truck-based carrier; operates terminals and maintenance facilities rather than warehouses

freight_specialization.value: Time- and temperature-sensitive refrigerated freight, plus dry van freight

network_lane_structure.value: Regional, long-haul, local and dedicated lanes across the U.S., with cross-border Canada and Mexico service, run from terminals

asset_based_intermediary_role.value: Primarily asset-based motor carrier, with a brokerage and logistics arm for added capacity

freight_operating_drivers.value: Driver retention and experience, fuel and MPG management, maintenance cost control, safety scores, and peak-season surge capacity
